verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official CLI that manages flags, segments, features, organisations, projects and environments from the terminal. It also offers SDK-style flag evaluation and raw API access, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: documentation of agent-oriented CLI ergonomics (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth for automation), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Flagsmith CLI lets you manage flags, segments, features, projects and environments from your terminal, and evaluate flags the way an SDK would.
The CLI covers flags, segments, features, organisations, projects, environments, SDK-style flag evaluation, and raw API access.
